title: Semantic-version change-class rule table
spec_anchor: WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json REL-0001: plugin package, registry entry, blueprint pack, CouncilSpec schema

rules.when: A key listed in required_keys_by_surface is present in the previous tree and absent in the new tree. Deleting a required manifest key is breaking even when the declared bump is PATCH.
The new tree declares a tool permission that the previous tree did not. Widening is MAJOR even though no key was removed.
A hook contract field (event, stdin_schema, input_schema, signature, args, handler, stdin) changes or a previously registered hook file disappears.
A blueprint id present in the previous pack is absent from the new pack.
A JSON Schema required-array at the same schema path gains a name that was not required before. Making a field required is breaking.
A previously valid JSON contract artifact is no longer parseable, so required keys cannot be checked.
An optional object key or schema property is added without tightening required, permissions, hook signatures, or retiring ids.
Description/docs/non-contract bytes change, or an unmatched file is modified, without a higher-class finding on that path.
A path changes and the byte payload is identical. A pure rename is no-bump-required.
